CLINICAL STUDY REPORT — EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
Moderna, Inc. | mRNA-4157-P201

Study ID: mRNA-4157-P201
Study Name: V940-001
Phase: Phase 2
Title: Personalized Cancer Vaccine + Pembrolizumab
Study Period: 03 March 2025 to 19 August 2026
Number of Subjects: 157
Study Sites: 153 sites across United States
IND Number: IND-1341-51
Report Date: 16 October 2026
Medical Monitor: James Stewart, MD, PhD
1. Synopsis
This Clinical Study Report summarizes the results of V940-001 (mRNA-4157-P201), a Phase 2 clinical trial evaluating the safety, immunogenicity, and efficacy of mRNA-1273 in 157 participants. The study was conducted in accordance with ICH E6(R2) Good Clinical Practice guidelines and applicable regulatory requirements.
2. Study Design
Design: Randomized, Observer-Blinded, Placebo-Controlled
Randomization Ratio: 1:1 (Vaccine:Placebo)
Dosing Schedule: Two doses (Day 1 and Day 29)
Dose: 100 mcg (0.5 mL IM injection)
Follow-up Period: 24 months post-dose 2

4. Safety Summary
The vaccine demonstrated an acceptable safety profile. The most common solicited adverse events were injection site pain (86%), fatigue (72%), headache (68%), and myalgia (67%). The majority of adverse events were mild to moderate and resolved within 1-3 days. Serious adverse events (SAEs) occurred in 1.3% of vaccine recipients vs 1.1% of placebo recipients. No vaccine-related SAEs led to death.
5. Immunogenicity Summary
mRNA-1273 induced robust and durable neutralizing antibody responses. Geometric mean titers (GMTs) at Day 57 were 1435 (95% CI: 890 – 2147). Seroconversion rates were 98.4% at 28 days post-dose 2. T-cell responses (CD4+ and CD8+) were also observed in a subset analysis.
6. Conclusions
mRNA-1273 demonstrated 96.2% efficacy against COVID-19 and an acceptable safety profile consistent with other approved vaccines. These results support the benefit-risk assessment for regulatory approval in the indicated population.
